# Authority, Reversibility, and Human Control {#sec-authority-oversight}

::: {.callout-note title="Outline scaffold"}

This page makes the agreed chapter architecture renderable in Quarto. It records the chapter question, planned coverage, and intended systems outcome; full manuscript prose, figures, worked examples, fallacies, and exercises remain to be developed.

:::

## Chapter Question {.unnumbered}

_How can a system delegate useful action while preserving meaningful human control?_

## Planned Coverage

- Capability grants, leases, budgets, and revocation
- Approval gates and intervention latency
- Reversibility classes and blast-radius analysis
- Human workload, alert quality, and automation bias
- Policy enforcement in the action path

## Intended Systems Outcome

Readers should be able to translate an organizational authority policy into enforceable runtime controls and escalation paths.
